# `verlet auth login`

## Synopsis

```bash
verlet auth login [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Sign in to Verlet via the OAuth device flow (default) or legacy showcase code.

## Options

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--api-url` | text |  | Override API base URL (default: https://api.verlet.co or the active profile's api_url). |
| `--no-browser` | boolean |  | Do not open a browser; print the verification URL instead. |
| `--kind` | choice | `'device'` | device = OAuth device flow (default). showcase = legacy access-code flow (finalized in Plan 28-04). |
